response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep technical craftsmanship, and a track record of building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or enterprise-scale feature flagging infrastructure — key requirements for the Principal role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience across languages (TypeScript, D, C++, Java) and scalable systems.
Proven ability to build and lead open-source platforms used by real-world organizations (GISCollective).
Strong data and systems thinking demonstrated through telemetry-like projects and performance-critical apps.
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or owning enterprise experimentation frameworks or feature-flagging systems.
Limited visibility into metrics-driven growth initiatives or AI-augmented engineering velocity projects.
Experience with distributed systems is implied but not explicitly tied to multi-region, high-availability experimentation platforms.
